push.title: D 3-3 vs LesMoms | You: 8.2
push.body:
buddskees, an 8.2. Like a good casserole, it's not fancy, but everybody's glad it showed up.

THE GOOD
+ 6 shots at LesMoms's goal. You kept knocking on that door like a Girl Scout with a quota.
+ 2 key passes. Chances like that are gifts. You were Santa out there.
+ Man of the Match, your 23rd for us. That's a captain's performance, armband or not.
+ On-ball actions 40, up from your usual 24. That's the version of you I'm building the team around.
+ Tackles attempted 5, up from your usual 2. That's what showing up looks like.

THE BAD
- Giveaways 12, up from your usual 5. That's the part of the tape we'll rewind.
- 1 of 6 shots on target. For next time: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound. Promise it's worth it.
- Missed tackles 3, up from your usual 0. That's the kind of number that loses matches.
- You and PhogsToffees share this one: shot selection. Tandem fix: cut it back to each other.
- This result ended our promotion push in Division 3. Ain't no hiding from that one. Good. Now we learn from it.

Daily reps: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

Remember, buddskees: Don't count the days; make the days count. Then count the goals.

You've got more in you. I've seen it. - Coach Lasso

push.title: D 3-3 vs LesMoms | You: 8.1
push.body:
PhogsToffees, you posted an 8.1 against LesMoms. Keep doing the simple things this well.

THE GOOD
+ Passes attempted 33, up from your usual 19. That doesn't happen by accident.
+ 3 shots at LesMoms's goal. Shots are tickets to the goal lottery, and you bought a stack.
+ 1 key pass. You see the field like a hawk sees a cornfield.
+ buddskees owes you a milkshake for those passes.
+ Won your matchup: 8.1 against their best forward's 7.1. That's the good stuff, like the corner piece of the brownie.

THE BAD
- 1 of 3 shots on target. Here's the deal: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is. That's a coach's honest word.
- Missed tackles 4, up from your usual 2. Best practice: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away.
- You and buddskees both got caught on shot selection. Fix it together: cut it back to each other.
- This result ended our promotion push in Division 3. That's on all of us, not just you, and all of us fix it.
- Giveaways 8, up from your usual 6. That's a habit trying to sneak in. Don't let it.

Coach's drill: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

Hey, PhogsToffees. Be a goldfish about mistakes and an elephant about lessons.

Practice makes progress. - Coach Lasso

push.title: D 3-3 vs LesMoms | You: 7.8
push.body:
A 7.8 from you, BellyTb1. Steady hands, clear head. We'll build on that.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at LesMoms's goal. You kept the keeper busier than a one-man band.
+ 1 key pass. Making chances is a gift, and you were Santa Claus tonight.
+ You and buddskees had more chemistry than a high school lab.
+ 2 of the team's 4 tackles won: the team ran through you. That right there is what good teammates do.
+ Fewest giveaways on the team (6). You earned that one the honest way.

THE BAD
- 1 of 4 shots on target. Quick one: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger. No sweat, just reps.
- buddskees struggled with shot selection too. Work on it as a pair: cut it back to each other.
- This result ended our promotion push in Division 3. That stings the whole locker room, and it should.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 7.8 (best was buddskees's 8.2). I'm not mad, I'm just writing it down.
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 22 (best was PhogsToffees's 33). Here's the fix: Check away, then check back. A two-yard feint buys you the space to receive.

Warm-up idea: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

BellyTb1, here's what I'd tell my own kid: The grass isn't greener on the other side; it's greener where you water it.

I believe in you. More importantly, I need you to believe in you. - Coach Lasso
